message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What You Need | How It Works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | The player who reaches the target score first wins the game. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards (4 “Wild”, 4 “Wild Draw Four”). | Shuffle the deck thoroughly. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | If the first card is a special card (Draw Two, Reverse, Skip, or Wild), treat it as if it were played by the dealer. | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table; play proceeds clockwise. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. | The direction can change with a Reverse card. | | **Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | If you cannot play after drawing, you must pass. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | Wild Draw Four can only be played if you have no other playable card of the same color. If challenged and found illegal, you must draw four cards instead. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. | If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. | That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Reverse, Skip = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | Add the points to the winner’s total. | | **Continuing Play** | After scoring, shuffle all cards (including the discard pile) and deal again. | Repeat until someone reaches the target score. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – Knowing what cards are out helps you plan your strategy. 2. **Use Wild cards wisely** – Save them for when you’re stuck or to force opponents into a difficult position. 3. **Watch for “UNO” calls** – A missed call can cost you two cards, so keep your voice ready! Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
